answer_raw:
The latest Claude models are **Claude Fable 5.2** and **Claude Mythos 5.2** (undated), while the latest ChatGPT model is **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26).

The comparison between the two centers on their design philosophies: **Claude Fable 5.2** and **Mythos 5.2** are built for daunting technical work, including hardware engineering, scientific research, and managing complex software projects [2][4]. In one experiment, Claude Fable 5.2 coordinated over 1,000 agents to build an operating system prototype in eight days [4]. **GPT-6.1 Terra** focuses on delivering fast and capable computer use at scale [1].

I would use **Claude Fable 5.2** for coding because it is specifically designed to set a new bar for complex software development and technical tasks [2].

**Comparison of Latest Models**

| Feature | Claude (Anthropic) | ChatGPT (OpenAI) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Latest Model** | **Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2** [2] | **GPT-6.1 Terra** [1] |
| **Primary Focus** | Complex technical work, software, and hardware [2][4] | Fast, scalable computer use [1] |
| **Coding/Technical Strength** | High-level project coordination and scientific/engineering tasks [4] | Agentic-scale computer use [1] |
